server_command.pounce-http3: python -m pounce serve --app benchmarks.apps.hello:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 54367 --workers 1 --worker-mode async --ssl-certfile <generated-cert.pem> --ssl-keyfile <generated-key.pem> --http3 --no-access-log --signage off

telemetry.note: peak_rss_bytes is the max under-load RSS summed across the supervisor and forked worker processes; cpu_percent aggregates the whole process tree. Null fields mean the platform did not expose process telemetry.

variance.note: sample groups with sample_count < 2 are snapshots, not regression evidence

caveat: Local protocol snapshot; no HTTP/2 comparison and no public product-level performance claim. Re-run on the target deployment platform.
